transcript.text: Hello Deepa Venkatesh, it's Ananya Rao calling from Blue Wave Beverages for our scheduled check-in.
Hello Ananya Rao, things are steady on our end, just a couple of items to discuss.
So, your competitor Coastal Rivals Inc. is offering the same industrial cleaning solvent at a lower price point.
That's been a real concern for us.
Thanks for flagging that clearly. I'll make sure this gets addressed.
So, there's a mismatch between the quantity ordered and what was actually delivered for industrial cleaning solvent.
That's been a real concern for us.
Understood, that's frustrating.
Let me look into what happened on our end.
I want to make it right.
We can offer a discount on your next order of industrial cleaning solvent and prioritize your stock.
Okay, that actually helps.
I appreciate you being upfront about it.
Let me go over the next steps before we wrap up.
Anamura will loop in the regional manager to review the competitor pricing concern.
Anamura will follow up with the logistics team about the delayed shipment.
Deepa Venkatesh will escalate the pricing discrepancy to the finance team this week.
Sounds good. I appreciate you following up on these.
Of course, Deepa Venkatesh. I'll send a summary email after this call. Talk soon.
Thanks, talk soon

overview.title: Blue Wave Beverages Check‑in – Pricing & Delivery Issues

report.executiveSummary: The meeting addressed two main concerns: a competitor offering the same industrial cleaning solvent at a lower price and a mismatch between ordered and delivered quantities. Ananya Rao offered a discount on the next order and priority stock. Action items were assigned: Anamura will involve the regional manager on pricing, follow up with logistics on the shipment, Deepa Venkatesh will escalate the pricing discrepancy to finance this week, and Ananya Rao will send a summary email after the call.
